title: Topics in Social Advocacy; Naturalization Workshop Practicum
description:
Prerequisite: GVPT319N.

Restriction: Must be in Government & Politics or International Relations program.

Jointly offered with MLAW325. Credit only granted for GVPT319O or MLAW325.

Participation in one weekend workshop/clinic is required; the date is TBD but is expected to be on a Saturday in early April.

The focus of this practicum is a naturalization workshop whereby students will assist eligible Marylanders in applying for citizenship. Students will work with faculty, attorneys, and law students to design, plan, and implement a naturalization workshop. Students will participatein assisting applicants. Students will cultivate a range of skills, including outreach, direct services, working with interpreters, and proficiency inU.S. naturalization laws and processes.
